verdict.rationale: Fellow provides searchable transcripts, notes, and an 'Ask Fellow'/MCP interface that lets users query past meetings and action items on demand (fellow-docs-21, fellow-docs-32, fellow-docs-53), which could surface prior context with the same people if manually queried. However, there is no evidence of an automatic pre-meeting brief, attendee-based meeting history surfacing, or open-thread summary delivered proactively before a call — the retrieval is user-initiated search/chat, not a built-in prep workflow. Missing for 10: automatic pre-call briefing tied to calendar/attendees, evidence of 'open threads' aggregation, and any UI showing past-meeting history contextualized to upcoming meeting participants.
